title: SIP-8163: Reserve `EXTENSION (0xae)` opcode
description: Reserve an opcode to be used as an extension prefix in non-Sila-L1 EVM chains
author: Bruce Collie (@Baltoli), Piotr Dobaczewski (@pdobacz)
laymanDescription: Other chains that run the EVM cannot add their own instructions without risking a clash with a future Sila instruction claiming the same byte. This proposal sets one byte aside, promising Sila sila-mainnet will never give it meaning, so other chains can build extensions on it safely.
benefits: Gives other EVM chains a byte to build instructions on with no risk of a future clash
Needs no execution client changes, since the opcode already behaves as invalid
Extensions can be proven on other chains and later ported back to sila-mainnet
tradeoffs: Permanently spends one of the EVM's small supply of unused opcode bytes
Defines no encoding scheme, leaving chains to coordinate through the discussion thread
Jump destination analysis must stay identical, constraining what extensions can encode
